data_fields.name: portals_per_room
data_fields.donor_constant: portal list stored per room in the level file

data_fields.name: frame_delta_clamp
data_fields.donor_constant: 0.2 s (not applied on cutscene levels in the donor)

best_idea: Walk the level's portal graph from the camera's room, carrying the screen rectangle each portal lets through, so rooms behind a closed door are never drawn, and draw each room under a scissor equal to that rectangle.
decision_why: Portal culling only pays off in indoor or dungeon zones that have a portal graph; open terrain needs frustum or distance culling. The per-room scissor and one-draw-per-material rule transfer to any zone draw list.
acceptance: In a 3-room test zone with a closed portal behind the player, the far room is absent from the draw list; a room reached by two portal paths appears once; and the frame DIP count stays under a fixed budget at 375 px.
